description: AI Design Engineer community plugin registry. Static index of plugins (collections of community skills) that extend the core 10 skills. To add a plugin, open a PR adding an entry here — see plugins/README.md.

plugins.name: a11y-audit-pack
plugins.description: Accessibility deep-audit skill that goes beyond the core review-critique scorecard: automated axe-core-style checks, focus-trap validation, screen-reader flow walkthroughs, and WCAG 2.1 AA conformance reports.
plugins.author: ai-design-engineer-community

plugins.name: motion-design-pack
plugins.description: Motion and micro-interaction design skill: token-based animation timing curves, entrance/exit choreography, scroll-driven motion, and reduced-motion fallbacks. Complements core ui-generation-structured when animation is part of the design language.
plugins.author: ai-design-engineer-community
